WinUI.TableView by w-ahmad

Repository: https://github.com/w-ahmad/WinUI.TableView
Pinned commit: 665fea52b8ad47a64187d0f202d5281b074f616f
License: [MIT, original text](LICENSE.md)

The Rust TableView implementation in `src/scene/table_view.rs` and
`src/scene/table_view/` adapts the community control's data view, columns,
selection, editing, header, filter and clipboard design to this SDK's scene
runtime. The original C# implementation is not executed by the browser.
Selected original source and templates are retained in `references/table-view/`;
their fingerprints and source location are in `references/table-view-source.json`.

The original copyright notice and license are retained verbatim. Gallery
distributions include `licenses/WinUI.TableView/LICENSE.md`; SDK declaration
distributions include the same license under `sdk-types/licenses/`.
